Where an ADU is permitted in accordance with Section U202.3, the construction documents for the ADU shall include a statement to certify that the premises are not located in any one of the following flood hazard areas:
   1.   Special flood hazard area, in accordance with Section G201.
      1.1.   Coastal A-zone.
      1.2.   Coastal high-hazard area.
      1.3.   A-zone.
   2.   10-year rainfall flood risk area.
   3.   Coastal flood risk area.
Each such statement shall be accompanied with the applicable flood area map.

Where an ADU is permitted in accordance with Section U202.3, the construction documents for the ADU shall include a statement to certify that the premises are not located in any one of the following flood hazard areas: 

 1. Special flood hazard area, in accordance with Section G201 . 

 1.1. Coastal A-zone. 

 1.2. Coastal high-hazard area. 

 1.3. A-zone. 

 2. 10-year rainfall flood risk area. 

 3. Coastal flood risk area. 

 Each such statement shall be accompanied with the applicable flood area map.
